text: Early Careers | Students & Recent Graduates | BCG Careers Early Careers At Boston Consulting Group (BCG), you'll find more than a job—you'll discover a place where your talents are nurtured and your impact valued. By joining BCG early in your career, you'll gain experience and skills that will bring you success beyond your expectations. From your first day, you’ll join an inclusive, high-performing team that values your perspective. You’ll learn through hands-on experience, mentorship, and world-class training, all while being supported to maintain balance and wellbeing. We’ll help you stretch your thinking, build confidence, and make an impact from the start. Explore working at BCG Frequently Asked Questions Explore answers to frequently asked questions about starting a career at BCG. Does BCG visit college/university campuses? Yes, BCG actively recruits at colleges and universities worldwide. Our team may soon be near you, offering insights into BCG and our career opportunities. Find out if BCG is present on a campus near you. Does BCG offer consulting internships? Yes, internships are a common pathway into full-time consulting careers at BCG. Join us as an intern and immerse yourself in real consulting work. Mentored by our experienced consultants, you’ll take on meaningful projects, interact with our clients, and get a comprehensive view of life at BCG. Internship durations vary by role and location, typically ranging from a few weeks to a year. Explore our internship opportunities to learn more. What other opportunities does BCG offer beyond consulting? We offer a variety of careers outside of consulting, including data science and analytics, product management, business operations, finance and more! Get to know our teams better by exploring the ‘teams’ section of our navigation. Ready to Apply? Discover opportunities that match your ambitions.
